traits.name: Destructive Vengeance
traits.text: ⬲ (divine, necromancy); Trigger An enemy within 15 feet damages the antipaladin Effect The antipaladin increases the amount of damage they take by 2d6 (2d6) and deals 2d6 (2d6) damage to the triggering enemy, choosing evil or negative damage. In addition, the antipaladin deals 2 extra damage of the chosen type with their Strikes against the triggering creature until the end of the antipaladin's next turn.

traits.name: Intimidating Strike
traits.text: ⬺ The antipaladin makes a melee Strike. If they hit and deal damage, the target is frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical hit.
